reports.title: Destination: Get Hooked on Ridgeland, MS, by Explore Ridgeland
reports.text:
While Barnett Reservoir is well-known for its 33,000 acres of prime fishing waters, experienced anglers know that the true secret lies in understanding the lake’s seasonal movements and underwater structures. The lake’s combination of standing timber, drop-offs, and submerged brush piles creates the perfect environment for crappie to thrive. The Rez is also unique in that its waters stay productive year-round, making it an ideal destination whether you’re fishing in the heat of summer or the cool breezes of fall.
Brad Chappell knows this lake inside and out. With years of experience fine-tuning techniques like long-lining jigs and side-pulling, Chappell helps anglers of all skill levels…

reports.title: Hot Crappie Team
reports.text:
Asked if they use minnows or any live bait, Dan said, “We try everything possible before using live bait, but we’re not against using live bait.”
“I’m not sure where I’m headed next,” he said. “My main goal is to somehow fish for a living. Once I finish college – I’m in my final semester – I plan to fish all of the major trails and start my guide service. I want to expand my crappie guide service. I’m just going to take life as it comes and see what happens. I enjoy making memories with my dad. My lifelong dream is to own a fishing tackle specialty store, like Grizzly Jig.”
